content:
The distance between post 1 and post 400 is \(399\) units.

When Alla is at post 55, she has walked \(55-1=54\) units.  
Boris is at post 321, so he has walked \(400-321=79\) units.

Thus their speed ratio is \(54:79\).  
When they meet, their combined distance is \(399\) units.

Alla’s distance at meeting:
\[
399 \cdot \frac{54}{54+79}=399\cdot \frac{54}{133}=162
\]

Starting from post 1, she meets Boris at:
\[
1+162=163
\]

\[
\boxed{163}
\]
